items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I bet that Dave remember that.

ctx.x: Ask him about Eddie Hickman. He asked him.

How's about Eddie Hickman? Eddie Hickman, well Eddie Hickman, he had a band. He had George McCullum, he had Artie Crasman, and he had Max Williams, and he had Little Lawrence, Little Lawrence Coleman, and Gitar, no, Gitar, yeah. He's dead too. I believe Eddie's dead too. I read in the paper last week if it's him, you know, Eddie Hickman, you know. It wasn't. I don't know. Oh, you don't know him, man. He's an old musician too. This shot fella, he wasn't much taller than me. He gets mad quick. He's a nice liquor…
